job.prompt: Create a realistic hero image for field service and mobile maintenance work. Show a portable tool kit laid open — a blow-molded case or professional field bag containing organized hand tools: insulated screwdrivers, combination pliers, socket sets, a torque wrench, and measuring instruments. The environment suggests on-site service work: a maintenance vehicle, industrial facility exterior, or utility setting. Clean and professional, not rugged-for-drama. Practical tool selection visible, organized layout, durable case construction evident.
